details: Ordinary ground (uncultivated, occasional presence of people)
Agricultural land and land used in various ways (private road, road in industrial site, campsite)
Area for operation of agricultural or industrial equipment of large height H (>5m)
Traffic lane (including rural road leading to a traffic lane)
Route for vehicles of large height H (>5m)
Proximity to silo (H = height of the upper part of the filling opening)
Building accessible to people and protruding parts (including footbridge, balcony, terrace, sports equipment installation, chimney on a roof, etc.)
Ground structures and protruding parts of buildings not normally accessible to people (e.g. antenna on a roof)
Vegetation (must also account for tree growth)
